method: Chrome real official GLTFLoader.parseAsync on each original GLB ArrayBuffer. Browser independently decodes source stride/accessor bytes and compares actual BufferAttribute/interleaved bytes for every P/N/index. Source linear PBR/actual primitive material identity, alpha and side preserved. Every source scene is compared with loaded scene through a geometry/material/transform instance Counter, preserving reverse-wound coincident CAD surfaces and repeated instances. No asset rendered in this all-files stage.
scope_notes: Exactly the398 unique GLBs independently resolved from60 RobotModel URDF visual references, matching runtime-visual-validation.json scope.
No additional whole-catalog FK or screenshot claim;12 representative whole assemblies have separate24-view evidence in three-runtime-validation.json.
All JSON meshes/primitives and all glTF scenes are checked, including optional CAD-guide scenes. Default scene identity is separately preserved.
Raw authored P/N/index bytes preserve winding and coincident opposed CAD faces; no welding or normal recomputation.
Material scalar/color preservation is checked on both original dependencies and actual loaded mesh materials; no material override.
JavaScript/GPU resources are disposed after each file; explicit GC is attempted every10 files.

reproduce.cache: Matching source SHA + fixture SHA + Chrome/WebGL identity + dependency version allow previous inspection reuse; endcheck detects any source mutation.

webgl.glsl: WebGL GLSL ES 3.00 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 3.0 Chromium)
webgl.environment: Official RoomEnvironment → PMREMGenerator.fromScene(sigma=.04); scene.environmentIntensity=1; environmentRotation.x=pi/2 for URDF Z-up

reproducible_harness_archive.contains: Small acceptance fixture source, exact dependency lock and snapshot-specific manual review hashes. No robot assets, Node packages, images or site deployment.

artifact_lifetime: Temporary HTML, server ports, local source snapshots and screenshots are session artifacts under /tmp/assetsmodel-session-three-runtime. The small source ZIP is preserved for reproduction; localhost URLs are never permanent hosted links.

archive_reproduction_check.install_result: 2 exact pinned packages installed from NPM cache
archive_reproduction_check.run: ASSETSMODEL_ROOT=<isolated source root> node run.mjs --only ufact-lite6
archive_reproduction_check.relative_path_audit: Archive index/imports use same-origin paths; server uses port0; scripts resolve their own directory; source ROOT is configurable through ASSETSMODEL_ROOT. Screenshot paths in archived historical manual review are relative to the harness; no hardcoded temporary location is needed to execute it.

independent_code_review.scope: Read-only review of scene-checks.js Counter/defaultscene/multiscene/geometry-material UUID mapping, fixture actual material identity/PBR/sidedness/alpha, typed row SHA and conservative primitive child-order fallback, and independent Python vs JS RzRyRx/Rodrigues/mimic FK.
independent_code_review.result: No obvious acceptance flaw found for the current representative/model scope. Reviewer did not run browser suite; runtime measurements remain from this harness.
independent_code_review.constraint: 1e-12 scene transform tolerance assessed against the current identity-node GLB set.
